text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a productive practice
session!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hang on—I'd better write down what
I learned
today before I go to bed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, today in training, I learned
about...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, this is the last page in my

notebook!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... I'll have to go buy a new one
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... I sure crammed a lot of information
into this
thing, didn't I? Haha...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially since Trainer took me on—the
sheer
volume of notes has basically
doubled! That's
kind of impressive.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and my times have really improved
as well.
Wow...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I'll have to thank Trainer
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Sakura Chiyono O
approaches me
formally, bows, and gives
me a drink as a
thank-you gift.
